description: This PHP source file is part of a CRM system module responsible for managing user groups, including creating, editing, and validating groups and their members. It includes functions for handling group member data, checking for duplicate group names or user names, and redirecting after operations.

methods.name: constructGroupMemberArray
methods.description: Processes an array of group member strings to segregate and categorize group members into subgroups, roles, role subordinators, and users, returning a structured associative array.
